propositions: The current per-criterion fan-out recovery explodes token cost (440 requests worst case vs 240 primary budget) and wall-clock cost (25-90s per criterion sequential) by discarding all verified work from a primary run that exhausts budget mid-verification

Primary run must incrementally bank criterion verdicts as evidence becomes sufficient, resuming successor runs over only the unverified remainder in criteria-bounded batches (≤8 standard, ≤12 frontier) from a shared request budget pool denominated as 1.5x ceil(criteria-scaled-floor/2)

Criteria-scaled primary step floor verify_step_floor(c)=clamp(8c, 48, 480) replaces the flat 480 constant to prevent manufacturing exhaustion: an 8-criteria ticket receives proportional budget (~64 steps) instead of 10x surplus that the runaway guard catches

Path-normalized read_file memoization collapses the measured 77% re-read tax by caching whole-file content once per path and slicing all range requests from cache, eliminating the 48-reads-of-11-files duplicate-execution waste

Finalizer always emits full-coverage verdict from banked evidence (verified criteria scored, unverified as met=false placeholders) and implements deterministic no-LLM fallback on finalizer failure to guarantee no verdict-less state when any progress is banked
A successor preflight must validate ticket/material/tree-sha stamps on the criterion bank and abort with a typed error on mismatch to prevent resuming a banked verdict from stale context
